exposure: magnesium sulfate and labetalol combined therapy
magnesium sulfate and nifedipine combined therapy
outcome: systolic blood pressure (at 1 hr and 4 hrs)
diastolic blood pressure (at 1 hr and 4 hrs)
cohort: One hundred and twenty pregnant women with early-onset severe preeclampsia admitted to a hospital between January 2010 and December 2014.
finding: Magnesium sulfate and labetalol combined therapy was more effective than magnesium sulfate and nifedipine in reducing blood pressure, improving gestational age at delivery and neonatal Apgar scores, and lowering adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with early-onset severe preeclampsia.
